name: Volumetric optical pipeline renders subsurface scattering and anisotropic hair highlights
description: Verify drawing a solid colored circular gemstone on canvas, selecting volumetric optical presets including Gem and Hair, adjusting discrete cel tones, and rendering volumetric subsurface scattering.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), select a green or purple color swatch, and click inside the circle to solidly fill and color it
Verify a solid colored circular shape is clearly visible on the canvas
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the 'VOLUMETRIC OPTICS & SSS' section is displayed
Click the 'Gem' material preset button in the optics panel
Select '3 Tones' from the Cel Tones quantization selector
Verify a dedicated tagged layer named 'Optics (gemstone)' is created containing simulated refraction and internal subsurface scatter over the ball
Click the 'Hair' optical preset button and select 'Smooth' cel tones
Click the 'Render Volumetric Optics' button again
Verify the existing optics layer updates in-place to render anisotropic flowing hair sheen across the ball
